scripts.install:all: npm run preflight && npm install --prefix Web/API/gadinodi && npm install --prefix Web/UI/gadinodi
scripts.bootstrap: npm run preflight && npm run env:sync && npm run install:all
scripts.dev: npm run preflight && npm run env:sync && concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix Web/API/gadinodi run start:dev" "npm --prefix Web/UI/gadinodi run dev"
scripts.dev:stack: npm run preflight && npm run env:sync && npm run db:up && npm run db:prepare && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run preflight && npm --prefix Web/API/gadinodi run build && npm --prefix Web/UI/gadinodi run build
scripts.start: npm run preflight && concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix Web/API/gadinodi run start" "npm --prefix Web/UI/gadinodi run start"
